activity_summary: At the Cross Keys you rehearsed the comedy with the column beside Costard still open. Garnish read no total. Kemp wanted another pass at remuneration, and you told him Thursday may add and this morning may not. Burbage was told not to licence him. The watchet gown is still fifty shillings unpaid. Phillips kept Sam's song for tomorrow, and you left the ladies' refusal where you marked it on Sunday.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a new line, named Thursday at two, and left the ending alone.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Held the book, kept the margin blank, and would not mix lines with debts.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked for another pass at remuneration and was told to say what is set down.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Warned him off marrying the ending, and kept Costard out of the first minute.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Left the cuckoo song for tomorrow and sent Nick to the top of the part.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Held the Princess on the book, and does not have the gown yet.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in The column still open

facets.activity: Rehearsed the comedy at the Cross Keys

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The column beside Costard is open, and I have no total to read you.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: The groundlings never paid a penny to hear what was set down.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I did not soften the refusal.
